Name: Mistycore
Author: mistyspring
Description:
[size=3][b]This mod has no effect on gameplay on its own.[/b] It's intended as a tool/framework for mod makers to create mods with varied functionality.


Mistycore is a core mod I made with many small functions that I don't think deserve their own mod. It's used by my redux mods for a more immersive experience. (While I'm not sure "-core" is the right term, it's the closest I can think of.)

This mod has some of the following functionalities:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Custom hoe dirt textures[/size]
[*][size=3]Custom location backgrounds, just like IslandNorth's sky.[/size]
[*][size=3]Adding critters to locations depending on chance and/or conditions.[/size]
[*][size=3]Requirements to fish in a location, and alternative fishes to give if those requirements aren't met.[/size]
[*][size=3]"Object hunt" command, which lets you make searches similar to the egg hunt.[/size]
[*][size=3]Custom tile actions, like: [/size]
[/list][list=1]
[*][size=3]Conditional warping.[/size]
[*][size=3]Questions with consequences (via trigger actions).[/size]
[*][size=3]Changing the game map after giving an object to the player, just like the golden scythe. [/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Custom game state queries.[/size]
[*][size=3]Custom trigger actions.[/size]
[*][size=3]Custom event commands.[/size]
[*][size=3]Playing an event after you make a tree fall down. [/size]
[/list][size=3]
This mod makes use of ContentPatcher to be edited.

[url=https://github.com/misty-spring/StardewMods/tree/main/MistyCore]Documentation can be found here[/url].[/size]
